papers.headline: The full Gaia colour-magnitude diagram with white dwarfs reveals a declining Milky Way star formation history
papers.summary: White dwarfs (WDs) provide a fossil record of the Milky Way star formation history (SFH) through the combined effects of stellar evolution and cooling.
papers.title: The full Gaia colour-magnitude diagram with white dwarfs reveals a declining Milky Way star formation history

papers.headline: Euclid data release 1 (DR1) - SIR spectroscopic calibration
papers.summary: The Euclid space mission is dedicated to probing the nature of dark energy and dark matter, through a comprehensive mapping of the Universe's large-scale structure.
papers.title: Euclid data release 1 (DR1) - SIR spectroscopic calibration

papers.headline: JWST Rocky Worlds DDT Observations of LTT 1445 A b and c in Secondary Eclipse Using MIRI/F1500W
papers.summary: The JWST Rocky Worlds Director's Discretionary Time (RWDDT) program uses secondary eclipse observations to determine the conditions under which rocky exoplanets around M dwarfs retain their atmospheres.
papers.title: JWST Rocky Worlds DDT Observations of LTT 1445 A b and c in Secondary Eclipse Using MIRI/F1500W
